D31-B11 settles BNCT: the boron carrier is a device-dependent candidate (C12).

As for coder A: BPA is the registered 'Investigational product' activated by neutron capture; coded as drug-device candidate, pending XL view on whether BNCT is treated as radiotherapy only. D31-B11 settles BNCT: the boron carrier is a device-dependent candidate (C12).
The only biomarker in question is IDH-wildtype used to define glioblastoma (Phase IIa 'Glioblastoma IDH-wild type, WHO Grade 4'), which is excluded from any_molecular_selection.

Under D31-B11 the neutron beam ('Investigational Device, DM-BTPS, DM-BNCT - neutron irradiation') is the activating device, not radiotherapy, and the device itself is not an agent; no other drug or radiotherapy is given with BPA.
D31-B11: in BNCT the regimen is monotherapy because the neutron beam is the activating device; each arm gives only BPA ('500mg/kg/3hr followed by neutron irradiation').
